import json,hashlib,ast,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import torch
repo=Path.cwd();task="RobotLab-Isaac-Velocity-Flat-LW-wheel-Roa-v0";run="2026-10-03_22-59-50"
root=repo/"learnings/policy_tuning"/task/run
skill=repo/".agents/skills/monitor-tune-isaaclab-training/scripts";sys.path.insert(0,str(skill))
from capture_run_identity import capture_run_identity
from capture_effective_training_config import capture_effective_config
from evidence_provenance import store_object,read_reference
from summarize_evaluation_batch import validate_batch
from run_evaluation_batch import validate_contract
def ref(p):return {"path":str(Path(p).resolve()),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
def write(p,v):
 with Path(p).open("x",encoding="utf-8") as f:json.dump(v,f,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False);f.write("\n")
oldpre=json.loads((root/"evidence/source/assessment-preflight-20261004-001.json").read_text())
oldctx=read_reference(oldpre["run_identity"])
original_files=[ref(p) for p in sorted(root.rglob("*")) if p.is_file() and p.name!="index.md"]
scope=[repo/c["path"] for c in oldctx["config_files"]]
for c in oldctx["config_files"]:assert ref(repo/c["path"])["sha256"]==c["sha256"]
oldsrc=read_reference({"path":str(root/"provenance/source-4c1261f5e66a9b4c6070d7b93afe1a3eb1fc013376cf95b8bcf4e3aae57d4ccf.json"),"sha256":"4c1261f5e66a9b4c6070d7b93afe1a3eb1fc013376cf95b8bcf4e3aae57d4ccf"})
old_eval=next(f for f in oldsrc["files"] if f["path"].endswith("evaluate_policy.py"))["content_utf8"]
new_eval=(repo/"scripts/reinforcement_learning/rsl_rl/evaluate_policy.py").read_text()
def roa_ast(s):
 tree=ast.parse(s);tree.body=[n for n in tree.body if not isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) or n.name not in {"_evaluate_motion","_reset_motion_observation_history"}]
 return ast.dump(tree,include_attributes=False)
assert roa_ast(old_eval)==roa_ast(new_eval),"ROA evaluator changed"
finalbatch=validate_batch(root/"evaluations/wheel-flat-final-std01-20261004-001/manifest.json")
assert len(finalbatch["cases"])==6 and all(c["status"]=="completed" for c in finalbatch["cases"])
base=json.loads((root/"evaluations/wheel-flat-final-std01-20261004-001/contract.json").read_text())
checkpoints=[]
torch.set_num_threads(1)
for k in [30000,35000,40000,45000,49999]:
 p=repo/"logs/rsl_rl/LW_wheel_flat_roa"/run/f"model_{k}.pt"
 d=torch.load(p,map_location="cpu",weights_only=False)
 state=d["model_state_dict"]
 assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in state.values() if isinstance(v,torch.Tensor))
 checkpoints.append({"iteration":k,"checkpoint":ref(p),"size_bytes":p.stat().st_size,"saved_iteration":d.get("iter"),"model_tensor_count":len(state),"actor_input_shape":list(state["actor.0.weight"].shape),"history_encoder_weights_present":any("history_encoder" in key for key in state)})
 assert list(state["actor.0.weight"].shape)==[512,62]
 del d,state
ctx=capture_run_identity(repo,task=task,run_id=run,host_id=oldctx["host_id"],backend=oldctx["backend"],algorithm=oldctx["algorithm"],runner=oldctx["runner"],seed=oldctx["seed"],training_command=oldctx["training"]["command"],hydra_overrides=oldctx["training"]["hydra_overrides"],config_paths=[c["path"] for c in oldctx["config_files"]])
ctxref=store_object(root,"context",ctx)
cfg=capture_effective_config(ctx,repo/"logs/rsl_rl/LW_wheel_flat_roa"/run)
cfgref=store_object(root,"config",cfg);assert cfgref==oldpre["effective_config"]
datarepo=Path("/home/server/liufengrong/sim2real_test")
head=subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()
tracked_status=subprocess.check_output(["git","status","--porcelain","--untracked-files=no"],text=True)
datahead=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(datarepo),"rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()
assert not subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(datarepo),"status","--porcelain"],text=True).strip()
protected=[ref(p) for p in scope]+[ref(skill/n) for n in ["run_evaluation_batch.py","summarize_evaluation_batch.py","capture_run_identity.py","capture_effective_training_config.py","evidence_provenance.py"]]+[ref(repo/"scripts/analysis/assess_wheel_roa_scale.py"),ref(repo/"scripts/reinforcement_learning/rsl_rl/evaluate_policy.py")]
pre={"version":1,"created_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"purpose":"Matched checkpoint sweep from 30000 every 5000; reuse completed final49999",
"run_identity":ctxref,"effective_config":cfgref,"checkpoints":checkpoints,"training_launch":oldpre["training_launch"],
"repository":{"head":head,"tracked_status":tracked_status,"protected_files":protected,"preserved_evidence_files":original_files},
"evaluator_comparison":{"previous_snapshot":ref(root/"provenance/source-4c1261f5e66a9b4c6070d7b93afe1a3eb1fc013376cf95b8bcf4e3aae57d4ccf.json"),"current_evaluator":ref(repo/"scripts/reinforcement_learning/rsl_rl/evaluate_policy.py"),"unchanged_ast_outside_motion_functions":True,"excluded_motion_functions":["_evaluate_motion","_reset_motion_observation_history"],"unchanged_roa_ast_sha256":hashlib.sha256(roa_ast(new_eval).encode()).hexdigest(),"diff":subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","5580c93377f79217fa609cf2c4031cdcb150e0a2","HEAD","--","scripts/reinforcement_learning/rsl_rl/evaluate_policy.py"],text=True)},
"baseline_contract":ref(root/"evaluations/wheel-flat-final-std01-20261004-001/contract.json"),
"reused_final_batch":ref(root/"evaluations/wheel-flat-final-std01-20261004-001/manifest.json"),
"reused_final_native":ref(root/"evidence/analysis/native-final-comparison-20261004-001/metrics.json"),
"reused_final_static":ref(root/"evidence/analysis/static-rightturn-model49999-20261004-001/metrics.json"),
"data_repository":{"path":str(datarepo),"head":datahead,"clean":True},
"finite_budget":{"native_new_checkpoints":4,"native_cases":24,"environments":1,"total_steps":120000,"simulated_seconds":2400,"seed":42,"video":False,"case_timeout_seconds":600,"static_new_checkpoints":4,"static_max_input_vectors_per_checkpoint":50000,"static_max_total_input_vectors":200000,"static_CPU_threads":1,"static_timeout_seconds_per_checkpoint":300},
"authorization":"User requested checkpoint sweep and chose standing drift and hip smoothness priority; compatible previous final tests reused; no source edits, parameters, training, export or git",
"ranking_preference":"站定漂移与双髋平顺优先，兼顾跟踪","criteria":oldpre["criteria"],"policy_description_required":oldpre["policy_description_required"]}
prepath=root/"evidence/source/checkpoint-sweep-preflight-20261008-001.json";write(prepath,pre)
contracts=[]
for item in checkpoints[:-1]:
 k=item["iteration"]
 c={"version":1,"batch_id":f"wheel-flat-checkpoint{k}-20261008-001","run_identity":ctxref,"effective_config":cfgref,"checkpoint":item["checkpoint"],"cases":json.loads(json.dumps(base["cases"]))}
 for case in c["cases"]:case["attempt_id"]=f"m{k}-"+case["attempt_id"]
 validate_contract(c)
 cp=root/"evidence/source"/f"checkpoint-sweep-contract{k}-20261008-001.json";write(cp,c);contracts.append(ref(cp))
write(root/"evidence/source/checkpoint-sweep-plan-20261008-001.json",{"version":1,"preflight":ref(prepath),"contracts":contracts,"new_checkpoints":[30000,35000,40000,45000],"reuse":[49999],"source":{"python":_controller_source,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(_controller_source.encode()).hexdigest()}})
print(json.dumps({"preflight":ref(prepath),"context":ctxref,"config":cfgref,"contracts":contracts,"checkpoints":checkpoints},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
